title: Layout-keyed immediate resource capacity reuse
scope: Two localhost Chromium processes sharing one host. 960x720 picture; every forward frame/effect retained. Dirty replica is diagnostic. Draw CPU wall time is not GPU timing; captured frames are not physical scanout or input-to-photon.

experimentNotes.a1: Packed matrices on; original per-renderer immediate allocation path
experimentNotes.b1: Packed matrices on; layout-keyed immediate resource pool
experimentNotes.a2: Return to per-renderer immediate allocation with immediatereuse=0
experimentNotes.harness: Strict full RGBA/camera per-frame audits compare against independent original immediate and matrix paths; performance probes use observer and every forward-frame draw.

rejectedExperiment.description: The rejected positional plan pool is replaced, not rehabilitated by these tests. Its original intermittent failure remains unresolved.
